certificate_wording: Mastemy Certificate of Completion — Acids, Bases and pH (Ages 14-17)

learning_outcomes.text: Describe the properties of acids and bases
Use the pH scale to classify solutions as acidic, neutral or alkaline
Explain how indicators show whether a solution is acidic or alkaline
Describe neutralisation and write simple word equations for it
Give everyday examples of acids, bases and neutralisation
Follow laboratory safety and use only dilute, teacher-approved solutions

integrative_case: Kai plans a safe experiment using only dilute, teacher-approved solutions and goggles: he tests household liquids with indicator paper, orders them on the pH scale, demonstrates a neutralisation, and writes up the safety rules he followed.

case-based decisions in the integrative case
